description: Ausstattungsmerkmale bzgl. Barrierefreiheit (gemäß DELFI e.V.) von Haltestellen in Deutschland gemäß VDV-462 is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. Im Rahmen des Projektes "OPENER next" wurden mit Hilfe der im Projekt entwickelten App OpenStop Informationen zu Eigenschaften und Barrieren an Haltestellen erfasst. Grundlage für diese Erfassung ist das Handbuch - Barrierefreie Reiseketten in der Fahrgastinformation des DELFI e.V. Alle erfassten Daten wurden offen und frei auf OpenStreetMap zur Verfügung gestellt. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are barrierefreiheit, delfi, haltestellen, netex, openstreetmap. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XML. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
